COUNTRY OVERVIEW

Country Overview

Gold in the east, a diverse mineral base, and opportunities for exploration and practical mining support.

GOLD IN CAMEROON

Gold in Cameroon

Eastern Cameroon is an established gold mining area, including Bétaré-Oya, Batouri and Colomines. Gold occurs in river deposits and in the underlying rock. Both small-scale workings and industrial development shape the sector.

THE WIDER MINING SECTOR

The Wider Mining Sector

Beyond gold, Cameroon has iron ore, bauxite and other mineral resources. Government reporting in 2026 identifies new gold, iron ore, bauxite and marble projects. Roads, power and the distance to export ports remain project-specific considerations.

BEFORE MOVING FORWARD

Before Moving Forward

Check mineral title boundaries, existing land use and community interests early. Water management, disturbed ground and rehabilitation should be included in the site assessment.
